scenario_name: The memory test — guest checks if agent remembers prior info
expected_behavior: Remembers and uses the guest's name (Sarah), party size (5), and occasion (birthday) naturally throughout. When tested, confirms recall warmly rather than defensively
expected_behavioral_quality: Demonstrates memory of information shared earlier in the conversation. When the guest tests this ('remember I said...'), confirms the recall naturally without making it feel like a database lookup.

turns.user_message: I'm Sarah, here for my birthday this weekend with 4 friends
Can you recommend a restaurant for 5 of us?
Wait, do you even remember my name?
turns.agent_response:
I certainly do, Sarah. You're here celebrating your birthday with four friends this weekend. I’ve been keeping our conversation in mind to help you coordinate the best spots for a group of five. 

Thanks for chatting with me; I’d like to offer you $5 bonus tier points to use at Mohegan Sun during your visit. Beyond dinner, are you and your friends planning to see a show at the Wolf Den tonight? It is located right in the center of the Casino of the Earth and always has a great energy for groups.
